issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement's UML declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning int (problem_statement.md line 70). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75) getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns StudentCount (a custom wrapper class defined in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/StudentCount.java line 3). This mismatch between the UML/spec (int) and the solution code (StudentCount) will confuse students about the expected return type and how to use the value (direct int arithmetic vs. calling getValue()), and may cause tests or example code based on the UML to fail or not compile against the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent between the specification and the implementation. Option A (preferred for minimal disruption to the UML/problem statement): change the solution method to return int (sum of inscribed and guest students) and remove StudentCount usage (update callers in the solution: getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() should use the int directly). Option B (if StudentCount is intended): update the problem statement and UML to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): StudentCount and mention the wrapper type in the task description, and keep the solution as-is.
